questions.text: What is likely causing the dehydration — reduced fluid intake, vomiting, diarrhoea, excessive sweating, or another cause?
questions.purpose: Identify the cause of dehydration to direct management pathway
options: Reduced fluid intake (poor oral intake, fasting)

questions.text: Are you currently unable to tolerate any oral fluids — everything you drink comes back up?
questions.purpose: Inability to maintain oral hydration requires IV fluid assessment

questions.text: Do you have signs of severe dehydration — dizziness when standing, confusion, markedly reduced urine output, or sunken eyes?
questions.purpose: Signs of severe dehydration indicate haemodynamic compromise requiring urgent IV resuscitation

questions.text: Are you diabetic, and do you have excessive thirst, very high blood glucose readings, or fruity-smelling breath?
questions.purpose: Hyperglycaemia (DKA or HHS) is a metabolic cause of severe dehydration requiring urgent treatment

questions.text: Have you recently been in a very hot environment, done strenuous exercise, or are you in a heat wave?
questions.purpose: Heat-related dehydration may progress to heat exhaustion or heat stroke
Dehydration in pregnancy (especially from hyperemesis gravidarum) requires specialist obstetric management
